description: A simple Android ContentProvider implementation named FileProvider that serves asset files from within an APK. It handles queries about file display names and file sizes, supports opening asset files as ParcelFileDescriptors, and streams asset data through a pipe to clients.

classes.name: FileProvider
classes.description: An Android content provider subclass that serves asset files from the application's APK, implementing methods for querying, opening files, and streaming data.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the content provider; returns true to indicate successful creation.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Provides metadata about the assets such as display name and size based on the URI and projection.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Not supported for this provider; always returns null.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for asset files, here assumed to be application/vnd.android.package-archive.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Opens an asset based on the URI and returns a ParcelFileDescriptor for reading.

methods.name: writeDataToPipe
methods.description: Streams data from an InputStream (the asset) to a pipe for client consumption.
